faq.title: Everything you need to know about CraftPilot.
faq.description: A few answers before you start analyzing your store.
faq.q1: How does CraftPilot analyze my Etsy store?
faq.a1: CraftPilot analyzes your store data, listings, SEO, keywords, product images and performance signals to identify problems and growth opportunities.
faq.q2: Do I need to manually analyze every listing?
faq.a2: No. CraftPilot is designed to analyze your store automatically and highlight the listings and areas that deserve your attention first.
faq.q3: What does the AI Growth Coach do?
faq.a3: The AI Growth Coach turns your store analysis into prioritized actions, helping you understand what to improve next instead of just showing you more data.
faq.q4: Can CraftPilot analyze my product images?
faq.a4: Yes. The AI Visual Optimizer evaluates image quality, product visibility, composition, background and other visual signals, then provides improvement recommendations.
faq.q5: Can CraftPilot help with Etsy SEO?
faq.a5: Yes. CraftPilot analyzes titles and keywords and can generate optimized listing content designed to improve search visibility and clarity.
faq.q6: How does the credit system work?
faq.a6: AI-powered actions use credits. Different actions can consume different amounts depending on their complexity. Your plan determines how many credits are included.
faq.q7: Can I use CraftPilot for competitor and trend research?
faq.a7: Yes. Competitor Intelligence and Trend Radar help identify market patterns, competitor gaps and emerging opportunities.
faq.a8: Yes. You can start with the free plan and explore CraftPilot before upgrading to a plan with higher AI usage limits.
